method: Code-only motion clips were reviewed without opening key.json. Twelve evenly spaced frames per clip were inspected at 200% nearest-neighbor scale, with the full 24-frame streams additionally measured for changed-pixel and one-frame-reversion context. Scores remain human judgments; objective measures were not converted mechanically into ratings.
